goal: Create a controlled photorealistic micro-expression board that keeps one fictional young Asian adult identity stable while only facial expression changes across nine cells.
audience: Character art directors, storyboard artists, and performance-reference teams who need a restrained expression study

content.subject: Nine head-and-shoulders appearances of one fictional 25-year-old East Asian woman, with micro-expression as the only intended variable
must_include: Exactly nine equal head-and-shoulders cells in a 3 by 3 grid
One stable clearly adult fictional young East Asian identity across all cells
The same low ponytail, left-cheek mole, charcoal crew-neck top, eye-level crop, studio lighting, and gray backdrop
Nine readable restrained states: neutral, guarded attention, cautious curiosity, restrained amusement, quiet relief, contained worry, disappointment, controlled anger, and near-tears composure
Natural skin pores, fine facial hair, stable catchlights, and credible eye moisture
must_avoid: Identity drift, apparent-age change, face-shape change, mole movement, hairstyle change, wardrobe change, or altered background
Childlike appearance, glamour styling, beauty smoothing, visible makeup, celebrity likeness, or sexualized presentation
Open-mouth yelling, theatrical grimaces, comedy faces, bared teeth, or streaming tears
Extra people, hands, props, text, labels, numbers, logos, brands, or watermarks
Cartoon, anime, illustration, CGI, or irregular collage styling

art_direction.lighting: One identical large soft camera-left key with gentle camera-right fill and neutral exposure

composition.layout: Precise 3-column by 3-row grid of equal head-and-shoulders portraits with narrow clean gutters
composition.viewpoint: Eye-level 85 mm studio portrait perspective with aligned eyes, head angle, shoulders, and scale
focal_hierarchy: Subtle eye, brow, mouth-corner, and jaw changes

objective_checks: Output is exactly 1254x1254 PNG/RGB without alpha
Exactly nine appearances of one adult identity appear
No visible text, logo, brand, or watermark appears
visual_checks: Face geometry, adult age, mole placement, hair, clothing, crop, eye height, light, and background remain stable across every cell
All nine requested micro-expression states are readable in row-major order without exaggerated acting
Eyes, brows, mouth corners, jaw, skin texture, catchlights, and eye moisture remain naturally photographic
The board reads as a controlled performance reference and is clearly distinct from a hairstyle board, beauty campaign, or emoji chart
